CONEXTRA Bonding Agent.name: CONEXTRA Bonding Agent
CONEXTRA Bonding Agent.description: High-quality acrylic exterior coating with texture and strong environmental resistance.
CONEXTRA Bonding Agent.more_detail:
CONEXTRA Bonding Agent is an acrylic-based high-quality exterior coating designed to provide durability and aesthetic appeal. It offers attractive textures and designs, and strong resistance to water, alkali, dust, mold, and UV light.

Coverage: [20 to 25 square meter/25kg]
Finish: Satin
Drying Time: ≈ [5 to 7] hours.
Application: using Spray, plastic or steel trowel
